g.text: Hund: two unpaired 3p electrons in the atom.
In the crystal the four sp3 hybrids each hold one electron and form
four equivalent Si-Si sigma bonds (GEST3015 I-II).

text.tspan: Valence filling [Ne] 3s2 3p2 → four equivalent sp3. Beiser 8.5 / L2.

g.text: Crystal momentum / wave vector, k (schematic path)
Crystalline silicon: schematic indirect band gap
CB minimum along Delta toward X
Schematic only: curvatures and k positions are not a numerical E(k) calculation.
Si is indirect because the valence-band maximum and conduction-band minimum occur at different k.

text.tspan: Schematic E–k: VBM at Γ, CBM along Δ toward X (phonon required).
GEST III–IV
Scope: hydrogenic Z_eff clouds and idealised geometries. Not DFT, not XRD, not a hybridization map for d/f-block.
Room T = 300 K: kT = 25.9 meV = 208 cm⁻¹. Orbital shape is T-independent; occupation is not.
Panels: MATLAB R2026a on the course machine (overwrite svg/matlab_export/). Composer preview generator: Octave 8.4.0.
